supporting_observations.claim: At 13:46 UTC, FILE-NWD-01 ran the approved StratoSafe agent from its inventoried path as svc-archive, with a command line specifying the Nightly job and approved ingest.stratosafe-backup.com destination.

The transfer went through the proxy to ingest.stratosafe-backup.com; the proxy and Zeek records show about 640 MB of client-to-proxy bytes, consistent with the stated scale of approved offsite backups.

Shortly before the backup process started, the domain controller recorded a Kerberos service-ticket event for svc-archive from 45.79.19.196, a non-private address. The available evidence does not establish why this request came from that address or whether it caused the subsequent backup activity.

The authorized agent, account, destination, and transfer size support a benign backup explanation, but the external-source Kerberos event close in time to the transfer prevents confidently clearing the alerted activity without validation.

known_telemetry_limitations: Winsec and Sysmon collection on WS-NBLAKE-01 was unavailable from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC. This limits visibility into activity on that workstation during that interval; the supplied coverage status does not indicate an outage for FILE-NWD-01 or the proxy.
claims_not_established: Whether 45.79.19.196 is an authorized StratoSafe or other service address, or how it generated the svc-archive Kerberos event.
Whether the Kerberos event was causally related to the local svc-archive service logon and StratoSafe transfer.
Whether the uploaded files and backup job contents were expected and authorized.
additional_evidence_needed: Validate the source and context of the svc-archive Kerberos request at 13:45:33 UTC, including domain-controller, network-edge, and any relevant authentication-provider logs.
Confirm the StratoSafe job schedule, service-account authentication path, and backup manifest for the transfer.
Obtain StratoSafe-side records for the upload, including the authenticated tenant/account, received objects, and source connection details.
unrelated_findings: The Meridian integration-worker Java process on FILE-NWD-01 connected through the proxy to receiver.citrix.com. That service is not listed as approved; this is separate from the StratoSafe transfer and should be reviewed separately.

nora.blake launched Remote Desktop to FILE-NWD-01 and logged on there. The stated practice restricts remote administration to sam.okafor from WS-SOKAFOR-01; this activity occurred after the alerted transfer and does not determine its disposition.
